Write atomic rank/PID-local startup receipts with no request-level logging.
Fail closed before AIPerf unless all 8 ranks and shapes 50-54 meet receipt gates with the active job ID, immutable experiment ID, decode-0 role, and initialized distributed process group.

pinned_source_review.observer_hook_evidence: Pinned decode capture enters torch_compile_decoration.patch_model with each capture shape and invokes capture_one_shape. FullCudaGraphBackend captures through self._device_module.graph; BaseRunner obtains device_module with torch.get_device_module(self.device). The observer wraps torch.cuda.graph for the target CUDA worker. A conditional memory-saver branch delegates to its adapter and is explicitly outside proven observer coverage.

source_evidence.limits: One H200 and synthetic MLP only; no Qwen weights, HPC-Ops distributed startup, eight-rank capture, quality or performance validation.
